summary: Daniel sees the Lord and others in a glorious vision—He is shown what is to be in the latter days.
meta_description: Daniel sees the Lord and others in a glorious vision—He is shown what is to be in the latter days.

footnotes.note21_a: IE But I will tell you what is inscribed in the writing of truth: No one supports me against them (Persia and Grecia, which is Macedonia) except Michael your prince.
